social.caption:
Do you know why a 15-minute day still counts? Set a floor, not just a goal.

Mini mode: five words, one grammar point, five minutes of listening. The box still gets ticked and the streak stays alive.

Day 1 taste:
予定 (よてい) = schedule
予約 (よやく) = reservation
約束 (やくそく) = promise
決める (きめる) = decide
続ける (つづける) = keep doing

Grammar: ようにする = keep trying. ことにする = a decision.
